summary.text: Darlene Mealy represents the 41st District on the New York City Council, which includes parts of Bedford-Stuyvesant, Crown Heights, Ocean Hill, Brownsville and East Flatbush in Brooklyn.
Her Council biography describes her work on employment discrimination and on opportunities for minority- and women-owned businesses.

paragraphs.text: Her Council biography says Mealy has worked for more than a decade for working families, women, seniors and youth in District 41.

It credits her with authoring Local Law 33 of 2015, which gave the NYC Commission on Human Rights responsibility for employment discrimination investigations, and Local Law 29 of 2015, which requires the commission to report regularly on its work.
As a former chair of the Committee on Contracts, it says, she contributed to Local Law 1 of 2013, legislation underpinning the city's program for minority- and women-owned business enterprises.
